Window size pad

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x7fc
Size:
0x4
Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

Padding register used only to force the elaborated usb_ocp_recovery addrmap size to a natural 2 KiB window ending at offset 0x7FC. The register block occupies the upper 2 KiB (offset 0x800-0xFFF) of the shared 4 KiB USB device subordinate window; usbhsd owns the lower 2 KiB (offset 0x000-0x7FF).

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:0] DATA r 0x0 Reserved pad

Field Descriptions

DATA - Reserved pad

Not part of the OCP Recovery register set. This filler forces a 2 KiB elaborated addrmap for the SoC AHB sub-decoder window.
